_about: The project home's five rows. A row is a stage-of-work as a filmmaker reads it, not one of the app's five stages: modules are placed by id and resolved through navmodel.moduleGroups(). `hue` is an existing class in tokens.css (hue-library/feature/visualize/plan/shoot) - never invent one. `sym` is a Material Symbol and must be listed in section-icons.json icons. scripts/test-launcher-rows.mjs fails a live built module that is in no row.
